matching_precedence: unique normalized family within the same sport
normalized_tennis_family_rule: Normalize case and punctuation, remove leading ITF and trailing MD/WD/Qual/Qualification/Qualifying. Inherit only when every matched historical sibling has one identical tier.
guarded_tennis_prefix_rule: For a new tennis ID with no unique family match, ATP/WTA/Challenger/Mxx/Wxx may resolve to CORE only when no UTR, junior/youth/Uxx, wheelchair, table tennis, padel, beach or exhibition marker is present.
audit_rule: Every runtime inference must be written to classified-universe.json with method, resolved tier and matched historical league IDs. Exact, inferred and unresolved event counts must reconcile to the window total.
collection_rule: Collect the complete sport/day RAW schedule first. Apply the versioned registry and audited fallback only after the immutable RAW snapshot and before event-level enrichment.
change_rule: Existing exact-ID canonical decisions always win. Dynamic fallback may not override an exact ID, resolve an ambiguous family or bypass an exclusion marker. New unresolved families require a versioned audited canonical update.
